shell_commands.command: pwd && ls -ld /testbed && cd /testbed && git status --short && sed -n '1,180p' /opt/peeky/docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md
cd /testbed && rg --files tests | grep -E '(acl|repli)' && ls src/valkey-server src/valkey-cli 2>/dev/null; sed -n '1,150p' /opt/peeky/docs/lang/c-cpp.md
cd /testbed && find tests -iname '*acl*' -o -iname '*repli*'; ls -l src/valkey-server src/valkey-cli 2>/dev/null; grep -nE 'acl load|ACL LOAD|start_server|replicaof' tests/unit/acl.tcl
cd /testbed && sed -n '450,515p' src/acl.c && sed -n '2190,2420p' src/acl.c && grep -nE 'user = NULL|user = DefaultUser|createClient\(' src/replication.c src/networking.c

cd /testbed && sed -n '950,1130p' tests/unit/acl.tcl && sed -n '1,150p' tests/integration/replication.tcl && cat tests/assets/user.acl && grep -nE 'wait_for_sync|wait_for_condition|start_server' tests/unit/acl-v2.tcl | head -35

cd /testbed && sed -n '1940,2020p' src/replication.c && sed -n '1710,1765p' src/acl.c && grep -nE 'proc wait_for_(sync|ofs_sync)|proc wait_for_sync' tests/support/*.tcl && grep -nE 'wait_for_sync|wait_for_ofs_sync' tests/unit/*.tcl | head -40 && sed -n '1,150p' runtest && grep -nE 'single|only|tags' tests/test_helper.tcl | tail -35

cd /testbed && tail -95 tests/unit/acl.tcl && sed -n '1,125p' tests/unit/cluster/transactions-on-replica.tcl && command -v apply_patch && grep -nE 'existing|config|binary|build_command' /opt/peeky/docs/lang/c-cpp-cookbook.md | head -40

cd /testbed && sed -n '100,150p' tests/support/util.tcl && grep -nE 'ACLCheckAllPerm|user == NULL|user != NULL' src/server.c src/networking.c && grep -nE 'existing|config|binary|build_command' /opt/peeky/docs/lang/c-cpp-cookbook.md | head -35 && command -v patch; command -v peeky; ls /usr/local/bin/*patch* /usr/bin/*patch* 2>/dev/null
cd /testbed && sed -n '1670,1710p' src/acl.c && sed -n '1,90p' tests/unit/wait.tcl && grep -nE 'wait_for_sync \$|ACL LOAD on|ACL LOAD.*replica' tests/unit/*.tcl | head -30

cd /testbed && patch -p1 <<'PATCH'
--- a/tests/unit/acl.tcl
+++ b/tests/unit/acl.tcl
@@ -1116,6 +1116,32 @@
     } {*NOPERM*channel*}
 }
 
+set server_path [tmpdir "replica.acl"]
+exec cp -f tests/assets/user.acl $server_path
+start_server {tags {acl repl external:skip} overrides {repl-diskless-sync-delay 0}} {
+    set primary [srv 0 client]
+    start_server [list overrides [list "dir" $server_path "aclfile" "user.acl"]] {
+        test {ACL LOAD on a replica preserves the primary connection} {
+            r REPLICAOF [srv -1 host] [srv -1 port]
+            wait_for_sync r
+
+            r ACL SETUSER default -set
+            r ACL SAVE
+            set users [r ACL LIST]
+            r ACL SETUSER bob +get
+
+            assert_equal OK [r ACL LOAD]
+            assert_equal $users [r ACL LIST]
+
+            $primary SET acl-replication-key value
+            wait_for_ofs_sync $primary r
+            assert_equal value [r GET acl-replication-key]
+        }
+    }
+}
+
 set server_path [tmpdir "resetchannels.acl"]
 exec cp -f tests/assets/nodefaultuser.acl $server_path
 exec cp -f tests/assets/default.conf $server_path
PATCH
./runtest --single unit/acl --only 'ACL LOAD on a replica preserves the primary connection'

cd /testbed && git apply --recount <<'PATCH'
--- a/tests/unit/acl.tcl
+++ b/tests/unit/acl.tcl
@@ -1116,6 +1116,32 @@

 }
 
+set server_path [tmpdir "replica.acl"]

+            wait_for_sync r
+
+            r ACL SETUSER default -set
+            r ACL SAVE
+            set users [r ACL LIST]
+            r ACL SETUSER bob +get
+
+            assert_equal OK [r ACL LOAD]
+            assert_equal $users [r ACL LIST]
+
+            $primary SET acl-replication-key value
+            wait_for_ofs_sync $primary r
+            assert_equal value [r GET acl-replication-key]
+        }
+    }
+}
+
 set server_path [tmpdir "resetchannels.acl"]

PATCH
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then ./runtest --single unit/acl --only 'ACL LOAD on a replica preserves the primary connection' > /testbed/acl-regression-before.log 2>&1; result=$?; tail -100 /testbed/acl-regression-before.log; exit "$result"; fi
cd /testbed && ./runtest --single unit/acl --single unit/acl-v2 > /testbed/acl-tests.log 2>&1; result=$?; tail -65 /testbed/acl-tests.log; exit "$result"

cd /testbed && git diff --check && git --no-pager diff --stat && git --no-pager diff -- src/acl.c tests/unit/acl.tcl && grep -n -A22 -B5 'STACK TRACE' acl-regression-before.log | head -40 && git status --short
cd /testbed && ls -l tests/unit/acl.tcl* acl-build.log acl-tests.log acl-regression-before.log && rm -- acl-build.log acl-tests.log acl-regression-before.log && git diff --check && git status --short
